counts.description: Array containing the number of repetitions of each string

strs.description: Data.Tuple object representing the unique strings

title:
Type containing logic for the custom serialization of a numpy array containing many repeated string elements.
The numpy is serialized via ordered arrays of the same size, one containing the counts, the other containing the
strings themselves. Each string in the strings array is repeated the number of times as the value at the
corresponding index in the counts array. E.g.
```
counts = [2, 3, 1]
strs = ["a", "b", "c"]
resulting_array = ["a", "a", "b", "b", "b', "c"]
```
name: Data.TupleRepeatedElements
